security_tool.label: Public-intake protection
security_tool.purpose: Verifies the recorded intake posture and high-level perimeter, privacy, header, Turnstile, firewall, and prompt-injection test coverage.
security_tool.authoritative_source: ARRP public-input controls and verified deployment readback

security_tool.label: Repository change protection
security_tool.purpose: Verifies CODEOWNERS coverage, authenticated branch or ruleset enforcement, and workflow-permission confinement.
security_tool.authoritative_source: GitHub repository administration and provider-native Security

security_tool.label: Protected-surface change review
security_tool.purpose: States whether a registered security-sensitive surface changed after its latest completed security review without identifying the surface.

security_tool.label: Automation isolation
security_tool.purpose: Verifies owner-only runtime boundaries, Elim isolation, and credential-broker confinement at a high level.

security_tool.label: Credential and access review
security_tool.purpose: Reports review currentness and whether a protected human action is required without exposing credential inventory or metadata.

security_tool.label: Disclosure-boundary verification
security_tool.purpose: Reports disclosure-gate availability, last completed validation, and its safe source revision.
security_tool.authoritative_source: ARRP disclosure gate and active owner-local control pack

security_tool.label: Recovery readiness
security_tool.purpose: Reports whether rollback and restore assurance has been verified within its governing review period.
security_tool.authoritative_source: Operational Incident recovery proof and owner-local exercise record
